page_title: MCI 1-0 NEW | Manchester City v Newcastle 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Jones interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:1.
86' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
86' Here's the change. Miguel Almiron leaves the pitch and Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) comes on as a substitute.

85' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Manchester City are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
83' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
79' Rodri (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
77' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
75' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Phil Foden (Manchester City), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
74' Rough tackle by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Manchester City.
74' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
71' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' The ball is cleared after Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
67' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Sandro Tonali will be replaced by Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd).
66' Alexander Isak goes off the pitch and Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) comes on.

66' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Nick Pope, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
63' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) takes a shot on goal, but his effort isn't precise enough and it flies a whisker wide of the right post.
63' Phil Foden (Manchester City) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robert Jones blows for a foul.
61' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
58' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
57' We are about to witness a subsitution. Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) for Joelinton.
56' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Anthony Gordon and he is replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
55' Rodri (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
54' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
52' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
49' It's a throw-in for Manchester City.
47' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Manchester City can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
43' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
40' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
38' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
36' Robert Jones blows his whistle after Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
34' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Phil Foden shows great vision to find Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the top left corner. 1:0.
30' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
27' Rodri (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
24' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
23' A pass by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
21' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
18' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
16' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
14' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
11' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
9' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
7' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
6' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
6' A long ball forward to Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is intercepted.
5' Great teamplay by Manchester City as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
2' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Manchester City will kick-off.
Robert Jones is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
